body:
Seattle City Employees’ Retirement System committed up to $60 million to Horsley Bridge Venture 16, a venture capital fund of funds managed by **Horsley Bridge Partners**, and up to $30 million to Brookfield Infrastructure Fund VI, an infrastructure fund managed by **Brookfield Asset Management**.

Get unlimited online stories, daily email alerts and access to P&I Searches and Hires content.

p: Seattle City Employees’ Retirement System은 **Horsley Bridge Partners**가 운용하는 벤처캐피탈 펀드오브펀드인 Horsley Bridge Venture 16에 최대 6,000만 달러를, **Brookfield Asset Management**가 운용하는 인프라 펀드인 Brookfield Infrastructure Fund VI에 최대 3,000만 달러를 각각 약정했다.
